acceptance_criteria_met: Detect and flag >90% of known data issues (missing values, outliers, format changes) in ingested data.
Validation checks run automatically after each data ingestion.
Alerts are generated for data quality issues.
Validation logic is modular and extensible for different data sources.

validation_details.unhcr_validator: Implements completeness, consistency, and plausibility checks for UNHCR refugee data
validation_details.worldbank_validator: Validates World Bank indicator data with year ranges, country codes, and value validation
validation_details.acled_validator: Checks ACLED conflict data for valid coordinates, non-negative fatalities, and proper event types
validation_details.nasapower_validator: Validates NASA POWER climate data for geographic bounds, valid dates, and plausible climate values
validation_details.validation_service: Orchestrates validation across all data sources with a unified interface
validation_details.ingest_service_modifications: Integrated validation calls into all four ingestion methods (UNHCR, World Bank, ACLED, NASA POWER)

test_results.base_validator: Abstract base class provides common validation framework
test_results.source_validators: Each source-specific validator implements required validation logic
test_results.validation_service: Service correctly routes to appropriate validators
test_results.ingest_integration: Validation automatically runs after each data ingestion

evidence_summary: Implemented a comprehensive data validation system that runs automatically after each data ingestion, detects data quality issues with extensible validation logic for all four data sources (UNHCR, World Bank, ACLED, NASA POWER), and generates alerts for failed validations.
known_limitations: Plausibility checks use placeholder scoring (0.0) - would be enhanced with domain-specific rules
Validation errors are stored in ingest run records but not yet connected to alerting system
Database schema may need migration to add validation_passed and validation_errors fields to DataIngestRun table
next_steps: Connect validation failures to alerting system (email/dashboard)
Implement domain-specific plausibility rules with proper scoring
Add database migration for validation fields if needed
